routes.description: List of domain-to-relay mappings. Each entry defines how mail for a specific domain is forwarded (e.g., to a backup MX or external relay).

domain.description: The domain whose outbound mail should be routed.

relay.description: Hostname or IP address of the relay server (e.g., 'smtp.example.com' or '192.0.2.1').

port.description: SMTP port on the relay server. Defaults to 25 if omitted or set to null.
